snippets.title: sqrt(2) is irrational
snippets.code:
theorem sqrt_two_irrational : Irrational (Real.sqrt 2) := by
  simpa using irrational_sqrt_two
snippets.explanation: Mathlib already proves the irrationality of the square root of two as irrational_sqrt_two; simpa only adjusts the statement.
snippets.explanation_zh: Mathlib 中已有 irrational_sqrt_two 证明 √2 的无理性；simpa 只负责调整命题形式。

snippets.title: Conjunction commutes
snippets.code:
example (p q : Prop) : p ∧ q → q ∧ p := by
  intro h
  exact ⟨h.2, h.1⟩
snippets.explanation: A proof of p ∧ q is a pair; swap the two components to get q ∧ p.
snippets.explanation_zh: p ∧ q 的证明是一个对；交换两个分量即得 q ∧ p。

snippets.title: Introducing a disjunction
snippets.code: example (p q : Prop) (hp : p) : p ∨ q := Or.inl hp
snippets.explanation: To prove p ∨ q it suffices to prove one side; Or.inl and Or.inr are the two injections.
snippets.explanation_zh: 要证 p ∨ q 只需证明其中一边；Or.inl 与 Or.inr 是两个嵌入。

snippets.title: From p and not p
snippets.code: example (p : Prop) (hp : p) (hnp : ¬p) : False := hnp hp
snippets.explanation: Not p is defined as p → False, so applying it to a proof of p yields False.
snippets.explanation_zh: ¬p 定义为 p → False，因此把它作用于 p 的证明得到 False。

snippets.title: Instantiating a universal statement
snippets.code:
example (α : Type) (P : α → Prop) : (∀ x, P x) → ∀ y, P y :=
  fun h y => h y
snippets.explanation: A proof of ∀ x, P x is a function, so it can be applied to any term y to get P y.
snippets.explanation_zh: ∀ x, P x 的证明是一个函数，可作用于任意项 y 得到 P y。

snippets.title: Symmetry of equality
snippets.code: example (a b : ℕ) (h : a = b) : b = a := h.symm
snippets.explanation: Equality is an equivalence relation; Eq.symm, Eq.trans and rfl give symmetry, transitivity and reflexivity.
snippets.explanation_zh: 相等是等价关系；Eq.symm、Eq.trans 与 rfl 分别给出对称、传递与自反。

snippets.title: Simplifying n + 0
snippets.code: example (n : ℕ) : n + 0 = n := by simp
snippets.explanation: The simplifier rewrites with the standard lemma Nat.add_zero.
snippets.explanation_zh: simp 使用标准引理 Nat.add_zero 完成重写。

snippets.title: Rewriting with an equation
snippets.code: example (a b : ℕ) (h : a = b) : a + 1 = b + 1 := by rw [h]
snippets.explanation: rw [h] replaces a by b in the goal using the equation h.
snippets.explanation_zh: rw [h] 用等式 h 把目标中的 a 替换为 b。

snippets.title: Applying a hypothesis and closing
snippets.code:
example (p q : Prop) (hpq : p → q) (hp : p) : q := by
  apply hpq
  exact hp
snippets.explanation: apply hpq reduces the goal q to p; exact hp then supplies the proof.
snippets.explanation_zh: apply hpq 把目标 q 归约为 p；exact hp 再给出证明。

snippets.title: Sum of the first n odd numbers
snippets.title_zh: 前 n 个奇数之和
snippets.code:
open Finset

theorem sum_odd (n : ℕ) : (∑ i in range n, (2 * i + 1)) = n ^ 2 := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [sum_range_succ, ih]
    ring
snippets.explanation: Induction on n; the successor step uses Finset.sum_range_succ and ring after the induction hypothesis.
snippets.explanation_zh: 对 n 归纳；后继步使用 Finset.sum_range_succ 与归纳假设，再用 ring 收尾。

snippets.title: Defining a structure
snippets.code:
structure Point where
  x : ℝ
  y : ℝ

example : Point := { x := 0, y := 0 }
snippets.explanation: structure bundles named fields and generates projections Point.x and Point.y.
snippets.explanation_zh: structure 打包带名域，并生成投影 Point.x 与 Point.y。

snippets.title: An inductive predicate
snippets.code:
inductive Even : ℕ → Prop
  | zero : Even 0
  | add_two : ∀ n, Even n → Even (n + 2)

example : Even 4 := Even.add_two 2 (Even.add_two 0 Even.zero)
snippets.explanation: Inductive types are declared by their constructors; proofs are built by applying them.
snippets.explanation_zh: 归纳类型由构造子声明；证明通过应用构造子构造。

snippets.title: Declaring a typeclass and instance
snippets.code:
class HasNorm (α : Type) where
  norm : α → ℝ

instance : HasNorm ℝ := ⟨fun x => x⟩
snippets.explanation: class declares a typeclass; instance registers an implementation for typeclass resolution.
snippets.explanation_zh: class 声明类型类；instance 为类型类解析注册实现。

snippets.title: Chaining equalities with calc
snippets.code:
example (a b c : ℕ) (hab : a = b) (hbc : b = c) : a = c := by
  calc
    a = b := hab
    _ = c := hbc
snippets.explanation: calc blocks display a chain of relations, each step justified by a proof term.
snippets.explanation_zh: calc 块展示一串关系，每一步都由证明项支持。

snippets.title: Fibonacci by pattern matching
snippets.title_zh: 用模式匹配定义斐波那契
snippets.code:
def fib : ℕ → ℕ
  | 0 => 0
  | 1 => 1
  | Nat.succ (Nat.succ n) => fib (Nat.succ n) + fib n

example : fib 5 = 5 := by decide
snippets.explanation: Structural recursion on the two predecessors; decide evaluates the closed numeral computation.
snippets.explanation_zh: 对两个前驱作结构递归；decide 求值闭项计算。

snippets.title: do-notation with Option
snippets.code:
example : Option ℕ := do
  let x ← some 2
  let y ← some 3
  pure (x + y)
snippets.explanation: do-notation sequences monadic computations; here the Option monad short-circuits on none.
snippets.explanation_zh: do 记号按单子顺序组合计算；此处 Option 单子在 none 处短路。

snippets.title: Length of an appended list
snippets.code:
example (l₁ l₂ : List ℕ) : (l₁ ++ l₂).length = l₁.length + l₂.length :=
  List.length_append l₁ l₂
snippets.explanation: Mathlib's List.length_append is exactly the statement that length is additive over ++.
snippets.explanation_zh: Mathlib 的 List.length_append 正说明长度对 ++ 可加。

snippets.title: Multiplying by an inverse
snippets.code:
example {G : Type*} [Group G] (a : G) : a * a⁻¹ = 1 :=
  mul_inv_cancel a
snippets.explanation: mul_inv_cancel is the group axiom a * a⁻¹ = 1, available for any Group instance.
snippets.explanation_zh: mul_inv_cancel 即群公理 a * a⁻¹ = 1，对任意 Group 实例成立。

snippets.title: Continuity of a polynomial
snippets.code:
example : Continuous fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2 + 1 := by
  continuity
snippets.explanation: The continuity tactic closes goals built from continuous operations (addition, powers, constants).
snippets.explanation_zh: continuity 策略可关闭由连续运算（加法、幂、常量）构成的目标。

snippets.title: Derivative of x squared
snippets.code:
example (x : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2) (2 * x) x := by
  simpa using hasDerivAt_pow 2 x
snippets.explanation: hasDerivAt_pow gives the derivative n * x^(n-1); simpa specialises it to n = 2.
snippets.explanation_zh: hasDerivAt_pow 给出导数 n * x^(n-1)；simpa 将其特化到 n = 2。

snippets.title: Identity tends to infinity
snippets.code:
open Filter

example : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => x) atTop atTop := tendsto_id
snippets.explanation: At the atTop filter the identity map is a tendsto map; tendsto_id is the generic lemma.
snippets.explanation_zh: 在 atTop 滤子下恒等映射是 tendsto 映射；tendsto_id 是通用引理。

snippets.title: Constant sequence has its limit
snippets.code:
open Filter

example (c : ℝ) : Tendsto (fun _ : ℝ => c) atTop (nhds c) := tendsto_const_nhds
snippets.explanation: A constant function converges to that constant in the neighbourhood filter nhds c.
snippets.explanation_zh: 常函数收敛到该常数（邻域滤子 nhds c）。

snippets.title: Membership in a union
snippets.code:
example (α : Type) (s t : Set α) (x : α) : x ∈ s ∪ t ↔ x ∈ s ∨ x ∈ t := by
  simp
snippets.explanation: simp normalises set membership through the defining equivalences of union.
snippets.explanation_zh: simp 依据并集的定义等价关系规范化集合隶属。

snippets.title: A set is a subset of its union
snippets.code:
example (α : Type) (s t : Set α) : s ⊆ s ∪ t := by
  intro x hx
  exact Or.inl hx
snippets.explanation: Subset goals are introduced pointwise; membership in the left summand gives membership in the union.
snippets.explanation_zh: 子集目标按点引入；属于左边加项即属于并集。

snippets.title: Using injectivity
snippets.code:
example (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hf : Function.Injective f) (a b : ℕ) (h : f a = f b) : a = b :=
  hf h
snippets.explanation: Function.Injective f unfolds to f a = f b → a = b, so injectivity can be applied directly.
snippets.explanation_zh: Function.Injective f 展开为 f a = f b → a = b，可直接应用。

snippets.title: 7 is prime
snippets.code: example : Nat.Prime 7 := by decide
snippets.explanation: Primality of natural numerals is decidable, so kernel reduction by decide proves it.
snippets.explanation_zh: 自然数素性是可行的判定问题，decide 以内核归约完成证明。

snippets.title: 2 is prime
snippets.code: example : Nat.Prime 2 := Nat.prime_two
snippets.explanation: Mathlib provides Nat.prime_two as a named theorem for the smallest prime.
snippets.explanation_zh: Mathlib 以命名定理 Nat.prime_two 给出最小素数。

snippets.title: Transitivity of divisibility
snippets.code:
example (a b c : ℕ) (h₁ : a ∣ b) (h₂ : b ∣ c) : a ∣ c :=
  dvd_trans h₁ h₂
snippets.explanation: dvd_trans states that divisibility is transitive.
snippets.explanation_zh: dvd_trans 说明整除关系具有传递性。

snippets.title: Sum over range (n+1)
snippets.code:
open Finset

example (f : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ i in range (n + 1), f i = ∑ i in range n, f i + f n :=
  sum_range_succ f n
snippets.explanation: Finset.sum_range_succ peels the last term off a sum over range (n + 1).
snippets.explanation_zh: Finset.sum_range_succ 把 range(n+1) 求和中的最后一项分离出来。

snippets.title: A binomial coefficient
snippets.code: example : Nat.choose 6 3 = 20 := by decide
snippets.explanation: Nat.choose n k is the binomial coefficient; decide evaluates the closed numeral expression.
snippets.explanation_zh: Nat.choose n k 是二项式系数；decide 求值闭数值表达式。

snippets.title: Ideals are closed under addition
snippets.code:
example (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) (x y : R) (hx : x ∈ I) (hy : y ∈ I) :
    x + y ∈ I :=
  I.add_mem hx hy
snippets.explanation: Ideal.add_mem is the subgroup closure of an ideal under addition.
snippets.explanation_zh: Ideal.add_mem 是理想作为加法子群的封闭性。

snippets.title: Subgroups are closed under multiplication
snippets.code:
example {G : Type*} [Group G] (H : Subgroup G) (x y : H) : x * y ∈ H :=
  H.mul_mem x.2 y.2
snippets.explanation: Subgroup.mul_mem combines the carrier proofs x.2, y.2 into a proof that the product lies in H.
snippets.explanation_zh: Subgroup.mul_mem 把载体证明 x.2、y.2 合成乘积属于 H 的证明。

snippets.title: Evaluating the polynomial X
snippets.code:
example : (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℤ).eval 3 = 3 := by
  simp
snippets.explanation: The evaluation homomorphism sends the indeterminate X to the argument; simp knows eval_X.
snippets.explanation_zh: 求值同态把不定元 X 映到参数；simp 了解 eval_X。

snippets.title: A 2x2 determinant
snippets.code:
def det2 (a b c d : ℚ) : ℚ := a * d - b * c

example : det2 1 2 3 4 = -2 := by
  norm_num [det2]
snippets.explanation: A self-contained definition of the 2x2 determinant avoids any Matrix API assumptions.
snippets.explanation_zh: 自包含地定义 2x2 行列式，避免依赖 Matrix API 细节。

snippets.title: A functor fixes its object map
snippets.code:
open CategoryTheory

example (C D : Type*) [Category C] [Category D] (F : C ⥤ D) : F.obj = F.obj := rfl
snippets.explanation: A functor F : C ⥤ D has an object map F.obj; the equality is definitional.
snippets.explanation_zh: 函子 F : C ⥤ D 的对象映射为 F.obj；该等式按定义成立。

snippets.title: Components of a natural transformation
snippets.code:
open CategoryTheory

example {C D : Type*} [Category C] [Category D] (F G : C ⥤ D) (α : F ⟶ G) :
    α.app = α.app := rfl
snippets.explanation: F ⟶ G is CategoryTheory.NatTrans F G; its component at an object is α.app.
snippets.explanation_zh: F ⟶ G 即 CategoryTheory.NatTrans F G；其在对象处的分量为 α.app。

snippets.title: An adjunction is a structure
snippets.code:
open CategoryTheory

example {C D : Type*} [Category C] [Category D] (F : C ⥤ D) (G : D ⥤ C)
    (adj : F ⊣ G) : F ⊣ G := adj
snippets.explanation: The notation F ⊣ G is CategoryTheory.Adjunction F G, packaging unit and counit with triangle identities.
snippets.explanation_zh: 记号 F ⊣ G 即 CategoryTheory.Adjunction F G，包含单位、余单位与三角恒等式。

snippets.title: An integral is well typed
snippets.code:
open MeasureTheory

example (μ : Measure ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) : ∫ x, f x ∂μ = ∫ x, f x ∂μ := rfl
snippets.explanation: The Bochner integral ∫ x, f x ∂μ is notation for MeasureTheory.integral μ f; the equality is rfl.
snippets.explanation_zh: Bochner 积分 ∫ x, f x ∂μ 是 MeasureTheory.integral μ f 的记号；等式按定义成立。

snippets.title: The identity is measurable
snippets.code: example : Measurable (fun x : ℝ => x) := measurable_id
snippets.explanation: measurable_id is the generic measurability of the identity map on any measurable space.
snippets.explanation_zh: measurable_id 给出任意可测空间上恒等映射的可测性。

snippets.title: The empty simple graph
snippets.code: example (V : Type*) : SimpleGraph V := ⊥
snippets.explanation: SimpleGraph V has a bottom element ⊥, the graph with no edges; ⊤ is the complete graph.
snippets.explanation_zh: SimpleGraph V 有底元 ⊥（无边图）；⊤ 为完全图。

snippets.title: Integral of the zero function
snippets.code:
open MeasureTheory

example : ∫ _x : ℝ, (0 : ℝ) ∂volume = 0 := by
  simp
snippets.explanation: The integral is additive and the simp set contains integral_zero; volume is Lebesgue measure on ℝ.
snippets.explanation_zh: 积分具有可加性，simp 集含 integral_zero；volume 为 ℝ 上的勒贝格测度。

snippets.title: Continuous linear maps are continuous
snippets.title_zh: 连续线性映射是连续的
snippets.code: example (f : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) : Continuous f := f.continuous
snippets.explanation: Bundled continuous linear maps carry their continuity proof as the projection f.continuous.
snippets.explanation_zh: 打包的连续线性映射把连续性证明作为投影 f.continuous 携带。

snippets.title: The identity linear map
snippets.code:
example (V : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℚ V] :
    (LinearMap.id : V →ₗ[ℚ] V) = LinearMap.id := rfl
snippets.explanation: LinearMap.id is the identity endomorphism of a module; its type is fixed by the annotation.
snippets.explanation_zh: LinearMap.id 是模的恒等自同态；其类型由类型标注固定。

snippets.title: Cardinality of range n
snippets.code:
open Finset

example (n : ℕ) : (range n).card = n := card_range n
snippets.explanation: Finset.card_range is the standard statement that {0, ..., n-1} has n elements.
snippets.explanation_zh: Finset.card_range 是 {0, …, n-1} 含 n 个元素的标准表述。

snippets.title: Factorials are positive
snippets.code: example (n : ℕ) : 0 < n.factorial := n.factorial_pos
snippets.explanation: Nat.factorial_pos is the positivity theorem for the factorial function.
snippets.explanation_zh: Nat.factorial_pos 是阶乘函数的正性定理。

snippets.title: Proof by contradiction
snippets.code:
example (p : Prop) : ¬¬p → p := by
  intro h
  by_contra hp
  exact h hp
snippets.explanation: by_contra closes a classical proof by assuming the negation and deriving False.
snippets.explanation_zh: by_contra 通过假设否定并推出 False 来完成经典证明。

snippets.title: De Morgan as a tautology
snippets.code:
example (p q : Prop) : ¬(p ∧ q) ↔ ¬p ∨ ¬q := by
  tauto
snippets.explanation: tauto proves propositional tautologies by classical truth-table search.
snippets.explanation_zh: tauto 通过经典真值表搜索证明命题重言式。

snippets.title: Linear arithmetic on Nat
snippets.code:
example (a b : ℕ) (h : a + b = 5) : b + a = 5 := by
  omega
snippets.explanation: omega decides Presburger arithmetic goals, including nonlinear-looking ones after normalisation.
snippets.explanation_zh: omega 判定 Presburger 算术目标；规范化后也能处理表面非线性的式子。

snippets.title: Linear arithmetic on reals
snippets.code:
example (x : ℝ) (h : x < 3) : x < 4 := by
  linarith
snippets.explanation: linarith combines hypotheses linearly to derive the goal inequality.
snippets.explanation_zh: linarith 线性组合假设以推出目标不等式。

snippets.title: A binomial identity
snippets.code:
example (x y : ℝ) : (x + y) ^ 2 = x ^ 2 + 2 * x * y + y ^ 2 := by
  ring
snippets.explanation: ring normalises both sides in a commutative (semi)ring and checks equality.
snippets.explanation_zh: ring 在交换半环中规范化两端并检查相等。

snippets.title: A self-contained additive monoid hom
snippets.title_zh: 自包含的加法幺半群同态
snippets.code:
def double : ℕ →+ ℕ where
  toFun := fun n => n + n
  map_zero' := rfl
  map_add' := by
    intro a b
    omega
snippets.explanation: AddMonoidHom is a structure with toFun, map_zero' and map_add'; omega verifies the additivity law.
snippets.explanation_zh: AddMonoidHom 是含 toFun、map_zero' 与 map_add' 的结构；omega 验证加法性。

snippets.title: Composition of functors
snippets.code:
open CategoryTheory

example {C D E : Type*} [Category C] [Category D] [Category E]
    (F : C ⥤ D) (G : D ⥤ E) : C ⥤ E := F ⋙ G
snippets.explanation: Functor composition is written ⋙; the composite of F : C ⥤ D and G : D ⥤ E is C ⥤ E.
snippets.explanation_zh: 函子复合作 ⋙；F : C ⥤ D 与 G : D ⥤ E 的复合为 C ⥤ E。
